Cliff.description: The Cliff is an imposing entity, its towering form reaching skyward like a silent sentinel, adding a formidable hundred units to the landscape, casting long shadows and challenging the boldest of adventurers to scale its sheer, unyielding facade.

Cave.description: The cavernous depths twist and wind through the earth, their irregular shapes and dark recesses offering unparalleled cover and concealment, perfect for those who wish to move unseen.
